name: Fear And Anxiety
overview: Scripture teaches that fear and anxiety are met with the steadfast presence and protection of the LORD, who fights on behalf of His people and commands them to be strong and courageous. Believers are reassured that God will never fail or forsake them, providing comfort even in the darkest trials. Trusting in the LORD as light, salvation, and strength dispels fear, as He hears and delivers from all anxieties.
